title: Independent audit of offline Markdown daily brief renderer
objective: Independently verify that MACRO-DAILY-BRIEF-RENDERER-001 renders only injected offline macro observations, preserves provenance and unavailable states, and introduces no collection, delivery, recommendation or execution behavior.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify source, migrations, tests, fixtures, task specifications, ledger, credentials, providers, schedules or delivery integration.
Do not execute Dune queries, use credentials, make network calls, send Feishu messages or run a database migration.
Do not approve any BSC/Robinhood adapter, collector, webhook, backfill, trading, signing or execution behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Only renderer and renderer-test files were added by the implementation task.
Output ordering is global, Solana, BSC, Robinhood, then data quality; Robinhood visibly states partial Uniswap v2/v3/v4 coverage.
Each rendered observation exposes query_ref, query_version, source_as_of, completeness and warning codes.
A completeness-zero observation is rendered unavailable and never leaks its numeric value.
No cross-chain score, market prediction, trading recommendation, buy/sell instruction or execution wording appears in renderer output.
No network, provider, Dune, credential, scheduler, Feishu or database-execution behavior is introduced.
